LanguageData.RimLLM_CompatIntro: Route another mod's LLM traffic through RimLLM's fallback chain, budget, throttling and usage statistics — without that mod having to support RimLLM itself. Toggles take effect immediately; no restart needed.
LanguageData.RimLLM_CompatTakeoverWarning: ⚠ While enabled, {0}'s own API key / model / endpoint settings are ignored — every request goes to RimLLM's fallback chain. Offline or local-only users (e.g. Player2, a local server configured inside {0}) will be switched to whatever RimLLM has configured.
LanguageData.RimLLM_CompatTakeoverWarningShared: ⚠ While takeover is on, that mod's own API key / model / endpoint settings are ignored — every request goes through RimLLM's fallback chain. Hover a row for details.
LanguageData.RimLLM_CompatOfflineFallbackNote: If RimLLM has no usable provider at request time (empty fallback chain, missing keys), the request silently falls back to the mod's native path and a warning is logged.
